items.title: 30.7.3 13C NMR se molecule ki banawat maloom karna (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 30.7.3 with Quick Check 30.7 answered (PDF 213-214). Answers need review.

blocks.text: ¹³C NMR spectrum se molecule ka structure maloom kiya ja sakta hai. Spectrum parhne ke steps yeh hain:

Spectrum mein peaks ki tadaad batati hai ke molecule mein carbon atoms ki kitni mukhtalif qismein (environments) hain. Agar molecule mein 5 carbon atoms hon lekin sirf 3 peaks, to is ka matlab hai ke carbons ke 2 jore aise hain jo bilkul aik jaise (chemically equivalent) hain.
2. Peak ki jagah dekhein (chemical shift δ)
Har peak ki jagah (ppm qeemat) batati hai ke carbon atom alkane, alkene, alkyne, aromatic ya carbonyl compound mein hai. Chemical shift ki pehchan Table 30.3 ke data se ki jati hai.
Peaks ki tadaad aur jagah ki maloomat se aise mumkin structures banayein jo compound ke molecular formula se milte hon.

Kitab ki misal: compound ka formula C₄H₁₀O hai aur us ka ¹³C NMR spectrum 3 peaks dikhata hai (Figure 30.8), yani molecule mein 3 mukhtalif carbon environments hain. Kitab is formula ke teen mumkin molecules leti hai: butan-1-ol, butan-2-ol aur 2-methoxypropane. Butan-1-ol aur butan-2-ol mein 4 peaks honi chahiyen, is liye yeh nahi ho sakte. Kitab nateeja nikalti hai ke 3 environments wala structure 2-methoxypropane hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ka nateeja (2-methoxypropane) shifts se nahi milta. 2-methoxypropane, CH₃-O-CH(CH₃)₂, mein oxygen se jure do carbons ki peaks (taqreeban 56 aur 72 ppm) aur aik taqreeban 22 ppm par honi chahiye, jab ke spectrum mein 50 ppm se oopar sirf aik peak hai. 69.0, 30.5 aur 19.0 ppm 2-methylpropan-1-ol, (CH₃)₂CH-CH₂-OH, se milti hain, jis ke bhi teen carbon environments hain; yahi sahi jawab hai. Yeh bhi yaad rahe ke C₄H₁₀O ke teen se zyada isomers hain (chaar alcohols aur teen ethers).

blocks.alt: 13C NMR spectrum: INTENSITY banam C-13 NMR chemical shift ppm, 200 se 0. Teen lakeerein: b 69.0, c 30.5 aur a 19.0 (sab se lambi), aur 0 par gulabi TMS lakeer.
blocks.caption: Figure 30.8: Aik na-maloom molecule ka 13C NMR spectrum (kitab ki Figure 30.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teen lakeerein = teen carbon environments; a (19.0) sab se lambi hai. 69.0 ppm wala carbon oxygen se jura hai (Table 30.3: C–O 50 – 70 ppm). Oopar 'Kitab ki ghalti' box parhein: yeh shifts 2-methylpropan-1-ol se milti hain.

blocks.prompt: Butan-1-ol aur butan-2-ol ke structures banayein. i) Figure 30.8 se samjhayein ke yeh spectrum in dono molecules se kyun nahi milta.
blocks.explanation: Butan-1-ol CH₃CH₂CH₂CH₂OH aur butan-2-ol CH₃CH(OH)CH₂CH₃ hai. Dono ke chaar mukhtalif carbon environments hain aur chaar peaks dete; spectrum mein sirf teen peaks hain.

blocks.prompt: ii) Butan-1-ol aur butan-2-ol ke spectra mein kaun si peaks (chemical shift ke saath) aayengi?
blocks.explanation: Butan-1-ol: CH₂–O carbon 50 – 70 ppm (taqreeban 62) aur teen alkyl carbons 0 – 50 ppm (taqreeban 35, 19 aur 14). Butan-2-ol: CH–O carbon 50 – 70 ppm (taqreeban 69) aur teen alkyl carbons (taqreeban 32, 23 aur 10).

items: Peaks ginein (environments), chemical shifts parhein (Table 30.3), formula se milayein.
3 peaks wala C₄H₁₀O butan-1-ol ya butan-2-ol nahi (dono ki 4 peaks); shifts 2-methylpropan-1-ol se milti hain.
